entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you want to talk about?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's gotta be 'shopped!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I have video footage too.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Please, let's not feign ignorance.[n]All of you can go to that other[n]world too, yes?
What're you talking about?
Us too?
Which world?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As I just said, I know everything.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's not just all of you. I am aware of[n]that world too...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Wouldn't all of you know more about it[n]than me?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I also know that when you traverse over[n]there, your appearance changes as well.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's because of those mysterious powers,[n]isn't it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I found out about that world[n]about a month ago.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This had been installed onto my phone[n]without my knowledge.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, it's the Nav...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: When the app activated on its own,[n]the scenery around me suddenly[n]changed.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Quite frankly, I still can't believe it myself.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But from the look of these photos, all of[n]you seem quite used to it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We've been listenin' to you blab on for[n]a while now, but cut the delusional—

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All of you are acting as Phantom Thieves[n]in the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I can say so with conviction because[n]I have the same power as you.
It's not us.
That's right.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No matter what you say, my belief won't[n]change.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So you admit it then.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll take your silence as confirmation.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: In all honesty, I've been curious about[n]you since the time of the Madarame case.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But to think it would end up like this...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We didn't kill anyone!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I believe that as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...How can you be so sure?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Because I saw another—the real culprit.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Who was it!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I couldn't identify his face... He had[n]a mask on, after all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Actually, when I took these photos,[n]I entered that world too.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's when I saw someone else moving[n]about, besides all of you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: He shot at me the moment he[n]noticed me.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's who killed President Okumura?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Most likely. At the very least, I was almost[n]killed by him.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: "I can't die here... I need to determine[n]the truth..."

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: When those thoughts overcame me,[n]I awakened to that power—a most[n]fortunate accident.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This guy has a Persona too?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This cat...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I swear it just talked...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Morgana. Our teammate who taught us[n]about the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Really? This is unbelievable...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But it IS true that you know things[n]that I don't...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Say, Morgana. Were you also the one[n]who instructed them on how to change[n]people's hearts?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I experienced that world too, but I still[n]haven't solved that mystery yet.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We go in the Metaverse—we call them[n]Palaces—to steal the core of their desires:[n]their Treasure.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And those whose Treasure has been[n]stolen have a change of heart.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hahaha... There's certainly no way[n]anyone could figure out such an MO.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways! Back to what you were talkin'[n]about! Are we in this mess 'cause of that[n]guy!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Although I don't completely understand[n]the method, all you do is simply reform[n]people.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Someone else is behind the murders.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, the police have decided[n]that the Phantom Thieves did it...[n]They'll arrest you at this rate.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Th-They're going to treat me as my father's[n]murderer?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I can't overlook such a grave mistake.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Which is precisely why I want us to strike[n]a deal. I may be able to save you from[n]this situation.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A deal?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I would like you to cooperate with me on[n]investigating the truth.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And if we decline?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then I think I'll have to inform the police[n]about all of you, along with that video[n]I mentioned.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This ain't no deal! It's blackmail!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Say what you will. This is the method[n]that I believe is correct.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The justice I uphold will not tolerate[n]criminals who kill people at their leisure.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Justice...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You've heard that Sae-san is the one[n]spearheading the investigation about[n]you Phantom Thieves, correct?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The higher-ups are concerned only with[n]settling the case.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: They want to capture the culprits behind[n]the psychotic breakdown incidents and[n]end the commotion.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Those are the ones who are putting[n]pressure on Sae-san. I can only imagine[n]her impatience.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What of evidence that we did it? How[n]do they intend on proving it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Even if there is no objective explanation[n]to the method, it's over once causality is[n]established.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sae-san can't make rational judgments[n]at the moment.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If she were to be cornered, well...[n]she may even make up a confession.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Make it up?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, they're gonna make it all our fault!?[n]Just 'cause they feel like it!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We haven't killed anyone though!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...And we're still going to be arrested?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You'll be found guilty if you're caught,[n]and it will be treated as a very serious[n]crime.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Bullshit! None of that makes any sense!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Unfortunately, there's nothing I can do[n]alone anymore to stop the flow of things...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And that's why you want our[n]cooperation?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes. In return, I'll turn a blind eye to what[n]you've done. Those are my conditions.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That said, I ask that you disband the[n]Phantom Thieves after this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What should we do about[n]Akechi-san's proposal?
Let me think it over.
You're demanding a lot.
Is that the only way?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I see... I don't think it's a bad deal[n]though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I see... I thought I was making a lot of[n]concessions myself...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I can understand how you feel. It must[n]be hard making a decision on the spot[n]like this...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, you don't have to decide at the[n]moment.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering this is you we're talking[n]about, I believe you'll come to a[n]favorable reply.
I can sense a bond of trust[n]coming from Akechi...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm glad we could talk. It's been a while[n]since I've been able to spend such a[n]meaningful time like this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I look forward to your answer.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was definitely worth coming today—[n]for various reasons.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We should be getting back.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...About that. I'm sorry. Would it be[n]acceptable if we ended the panel here?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The reason why you called for me in the[n]first place was because you wanted intel,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: My business is concluded as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll deal with it somehow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit! He had complete control[n]over us!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, they're going...
I feel like my bond with[n]Akechi is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Я відчуваю, що мій зв'язок[n]з Акеті поглиблюється...
